verdict.rationale: Treg stores team tool registrations, shared credentials, call history, reviews and prepaid billing usage, so data export and portability is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no export of any of that account data in any format: the self-hosting evidence (open repo, a community one-click deploy report) is an exit path for the software, not for hosted data, and no migration path from treg.to to a self-hosted instance is documented. Missing for 10: a documented data-export feature, open or standard export formats, a hosted-to-self-hosted migration path, and independent confirmation of a clean exit.
